# Check if Matrix Is X-Matrix.

@example Every marked cell is non-zero and every other cell is 0; the middle cell, 4, lies on both strokes.
[[7,0,0,0,3],[0,1,0,9,0],[0,0,4,0,0],[0,8,0,2,0],[6,0,0,0,5]]
=> true

@example Row 3, column 2 is not marked (3 + 2 is not 3), yet it holds 9.
[[1,0,0,2],[0,3,4,0],[0,5,6,0],[7,0,9,8]]
=> false

@example The middle cell is marked, and it holds 0.
[[2,0,2],[0,0,0],[2,0,2]]
=> false

# The smallest side, with the smallest non-zero value.
[[1,0,1],[0,1,0],[1,0,1]]
=> true

# All zeros.
[[0,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,0]]
=> false

# Every cell non-zero.
[[3,3,3],[3,3,3],[3,3,3]]
=> false

# The main diagonal is all non-zero, but the anti-diagonal has a 0 in the
# top-right corner.
[[5,0,0,0],[0,5,5,0],[0,5,5,0],[5,0,0,5]]
=> false

# The anti-diagonal is all non-zero, but the last cell is 0.
[[2,0,0,0,2],[0,2,0,2,0],[0,0,2,0,0],[0,2,0,2,0],[2,0,0,0,0]]
=> false

# A non-zero cell right next to a corner.
[[4,1,0,4],[0,4,4,0],[0,4,4,0],[4,0,0,4]]
=> false

# The second stroke drawn one place too low (i + j == n): the top-right
# corner is 0, and (1,3) and (3,1) are non-zero though unmarked.
[[3,0,0,0],[0,3,0,3],[0,0,3,0],[0,3,0,3]]
=> false

# A 0 at (1,2) on the X, traded for a non-zero at (1,0) off it: there are
# still 2n = 8 non-zero cells.
[[4,0,0,4],[4,4,0,0],[0,4,4,0],[4,0,0,4]]
=> false

# Odd side: 2n - 1 = 13 marked cells.
[[1,0,0,0,0,0,2],[0,3,0,0,0,4,0],[0,0,5,0,6,0,0],[0,0,0,7,0,0,0],[0,0,8,0,9,0,0],[0,10,0,0,0,11,0],[12,0,0,0,0,0,13]]
=> true

# The largest values.
[[100000,0,0,100000],[0,100000,100000,0],[0,100000,100000,0],[100000,0,0,100000]]
=> true

# 65536 = 2^16 in all nine marked cells: their product wraps to 0 in 32 and
# in 64 bits.
[[65536,0,0,0,65536],[0,65536,0,65536,0],[0,0,65536,0,0],[0,65536,0,65536,0],[65536,0,0,0,65536]]
=> true

# Even side: a stray 1 in the last row, at (5,1).
[[100000,0,0,0,0,100000],[0,100000,0,0,100000,0],[0,0,100000,100000,0,0],[0,0,100000,100000,0,0],[0,100000,0,0,100000,0],[100000,1,0,0,0,100000]]
=> false

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).

@gen 17 small
[[65536,0,0,0,0,0,0],[0,65536,0,0,0,0,65536],[0,0,65536,0,0,65536,0],[0,0,0,65536,65536,0,0],[0,0,0,65536,65536,0,0],[0,0,65536,0,0,65536,0],[0,65536,0,0,0,0,65536]]
=> false

@gen 20 small
[[0,70588,5868],[0,39930,0],[3565,0,83609]]

@gen 23 small
[[0,0,0,0,3,0,0],[0,8,8,0,0,7,0],[7,0,0,0,7,1,1],[0,0,0,0,5,0,0],[0,9,0,7,0,0,0],[3,0,6,0,6,4,1],[0,0,0,0,0,0,0]]
